request: Build a 2048 puzzle game in a single HTML file. A 4x4 grid where arrow keys or WASD slide all tiles, equal adjacent tiles merge into their double with score gain, a new 2 or 4 tile spawns after every valid move, game over is detected when no merges remain, winning at 2048 shows a message while play continues, the best score persists in localStorage, and tiles are colored by value.

planFiles.summary: 2048 HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
